The agent never found or read the App.config content (despite the task prompt explicitly emphasizing this), invented an incorrect theory about Azure.Core being compiled against .NET 10 runtime, and proposed upgrading to net10.0 rather than fixing the actual config issue. The investigation was thorough in terms of effort (132 tool calls, 1038 seconds) but ultimately reached incorrect conclusions on the most critical aspects.
